note.subject: Shadow Hunter STEP 6 - voice matched to every shot, correct movements (reply: done / not done)
note.text:
Shadow Hunter STEP 6: the first 30 seconds, fixed against the shot-by-shot check I sent you earlier tonight.

VOICE AND PICTURE (your "voice not matching")
- Each line now plays only over the shots it talks about:
  - 3.0-5.9 s "कुछ साल पहले, दुनिया में राक्षस आने लगे" over the lightning and the TV news of the gate
  - 6.1-8.4 s "और कुछ आम लोग… शिकारी बन गए" over the two hunters leaping (now big and clear)
  - 12.2-13.4 s Vikram's "अरे, E-रैंक अर्जुन!", lip-synced on his own model-sheet drawing, mouth closed before and after
  - 13.6-16.0 s "अर्जुन उनमें सबसे कमज़ोर है" over Arjun's close-up, his mouth closed
  - 18.5-21.9 s "तीन साल से उसकी माँ अस्पताल में है" over his mother in the hospital
- No line runs into the next shot. Subtitles show exactly while the line is spoken.
- No mouth moves without a line. The S19 "talking" Arjun is gone.

MOVEMENT (your "video movement / character movement not correct")
I used the AI video only where it moved things correctly (the street, the TV, Arjun's hood close-up, his back, the window). Everything else is drawn animation of the model-sheet characters:
- Arjun walks: 12 drawings, legs and arms swinging.
- The umbrella walkers walk, and the car drives past and splashes.
- The two hunters crouch, launch, fly and land.
- His WHITE sneaker steps into the puddle.
- The hand tightens on the bill.
- His jaw tightens and he looks up.
I also redrew the mother older: grey streak, lined face, gaunt.

SCORES
- check_render_log: 8/8
- check_animation: 8/8
- check_against_reference: 14/15 (the one fail: edge detail 0.10, target 0.08)
- composite_check: 0 errors
- Sound: -14.7 LUFS, loudness range 12.2 LU, narration -18 LUFS short-term.

STILL NOT PERFECT (honest list)
- Vikram's lip movement is small: Wav2Lip on a drawn face gives modest mouth shapes.
- The cafe is still a warm, bright interior.
- Kabir is still not in the cafe shot. His drawing keeps losing its head when it is cut out.
- The doorway shot (S16) is a bright corridor, and the two-hands shot (S17) moves only a little.
- In the wide hospital shot (S13) the mother is small, so her age shows best in her close-up (S14).
- The model sheets' expression, mouth and eye cells still need to be made again.

Reply "done" to go on to the next 30 seconds, or "not done: <what to change>" and I will fix exactly that.
